note: Owner-time defaults for the ROI calculator. Every value is an assumption the owner should correct; each cites the coaching estimate it was read from, or says it has none.

missed_calls.basis: Coaching estimate: about 30 minutes to set up, then a few minutes a day for callbacks.

slow_response.basis: Coaching estimate: about 20 minutes to agree the texts, then a few minutes a day.

booking_friction.basis: No coaching estimate on file; a rough guess.

unanswered_reviews.basis: Coaching estimate: about 10 minutes per reply to read and approve a draft; about 6 replies a month assumed.

no_website.basis: No coaching estimate on file; a rough guess for reviewing a one-page site.
